title: Spectrum formula for the discrete Bernoulli displacement model when $|\lambda|>2$

$$\Sigma_\lambda=\sigma(h_{\nu^*,\lambda})\cup\sigma(h_{\omega_1,\lambda}).$$

title: Goldberg–Seymour conjecture for equality in Vizing’s multigraph bound
statement:
Let $G$ be a multigraph with maximum edge multiplicity $\\mu(G)\ge 2$. Then
\[
\chi'(G)=\Delta(G)+\mu(G)
\]
if and only if there exists an odd subset $S\subseteq V(G)$ with $|S|\ge 3$ such that
\[
|E[S]|>\frac{|S|-1}{2}\bigl(\Delta(G)+\mu(G)-1\bigr).
\]

\Psi_\lambda\circ\Psi_\Delta^{-1}=\lambda_2
\]
